entities.name: Nemanja Dangubić

entities.summary: Nemanja Dangubić is a Serbian professional basketball player for Dubai Basketball of the ABA League and the EuroLeague. His drafts rights are owned by the Memphis Grizzlies of the NBA. He was selected by the Philadelphia 76ers with the 54th overall pick in the 2014 NBA draft.
